color.note: Light is primary and the fallback for missing values. Every token has both values. Text/background pairs are checked at 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text, borders, focus rings and icons) in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Page ground of both apps (light: plugsuit white with a cool bias; dark: near-black with a violet bias). Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, inputs, chat bubbles and table rows: the first raised layer above surface-000.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Wells, table headers, hovered rows, the assistant's chat log and any inset area inside surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Selected rows, pressed controls and off-state switch tracks. The highest neutral layer; text on it must be ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-000, -100, -200 and -300, on the soft tints (violet-soft, pattern-soft, sync-soft, alert-soft, crimson-soft) and on hazard. Not for text on field or on a solid fill: those have their own on-* token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, labels and telemetry captions on surface-000 to surface-300 and on every soft tint. 4.5:1 or better on all of them in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: dividers, table row rules, the hex field. Below 3:1, so never use it as the sole boundary of a control or the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, chamfer edges of cards and inputs, corner ticks and unchecked marks. At least 3:1 on surface-000 to surface-300 in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal sheets and the chat panel on mobile. Alpha color; never a text background.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, primary text links inside back-office chrome, selected-state marks and HANDED_OFF. As text or icon it reads on surface-000 to surface-300 and violet-soft; the fill takes on-violet.

tokens.name: violet-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a primary action. The label stays on-violet.

tokens.name: violet-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind violet text, secondary-button hover, HANDED_OFF chip ground.

tokens.name: on-violet
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on a violet or violet-hover fill (the primary button label, the customer's chat bubble). Dark in the dark theme because violet lightens there.

tokens.name: pattern
tokens.usage: Pattern blue: the brand wordmark, links, focus rings, informational states and IDENTIFIED. Reads as text on surface-000 to surface-300 and pattern-soft in both themes.

tokens.name: pattern-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind pattern text: info banners, IDENTIFIED chip ground.

tokens.name: on-pattern
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid pattern fill (rare: badges, the info icon block).

tokens.name: sync
tokens.usage: Sync green: success, synced, verified, live. Darker forest green on light so it clears 4.5:1 on every surface; neon on dark. Used for VERIFIED, ACTIVE, decided gauges and the receipt edge.

tokens.name: sync-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind sync text: VERIFIED chip, the VERIFIED AGAINST DATABASE stamp, success banners.

tokens.name: on-sync
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid sync fill.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Alert orange text and icons: caution, OTP_PENDING, HIGH priority, abstained gauges. Burnt orange on light so it clears 4.5:1; bright on dark.

tokens.name: alert-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind alert text: caution banners, OTP_PENDING chip ground.

tokens.name: on-alert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid alert fill.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Crimson: danger, critical, LOCKED, BLOCKED, URGENT priority, destructive buttons, invalid inputs. Never used for decoration.

tokens.name: crimson-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind crimson text: critical banners, LOCKED and BLOCKED chip ground.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid crimson fill (the danger button label).

tokens.name: hazard
tokens.usage: Bright orange of the hazard stripe. A decorative fill only, never text, and only on warning and critical surfaces. Same value in both themes; the stripe reads through its alternation with hazard-ink.

tokens.name: hazard-ink
tokens.usage: The dark half of the hazard stripe, and the text color on a solid hazard fill (7.7:1 light, 9.6:1 dark).

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Absolute-field surface: deep violet in both themes. Cover blocks, the S2 promo and hero bands. Text on it is on-field, on-field-muted or field-accent.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Primary text on field (12:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: on-field-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and small print on field (7:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: field-accent
tokens.usage: Neon sync green for text, rules and the glow on field only. Do not place it on the light surfaces: it fails contrast there.

tokens.name: wordmark
tokens.usage: The PATTERN BLUE wordmark and product name in headers. An alias of pattern.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Underlined always; an alias of pattern.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid outline with a 3px offset. At least 3:1 on surface-000 to surface-300 in both themes. An alias of pattern.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success feedback color. An alias of sync; always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution feedback color. An alias of alert; always paired with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger and critical feedback color. An alias of crimson; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational feedback color. An alias of pattern; paired with an info icon and a word.

tokens.name: state-anonymous
tokens.usage: ANONYMOUS: nobody identified yet. Neutral: no claim about the customer. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-anonymous-bg.

tokens.name: state-anonymous-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the ANONYMOUS chip. Pair only with state-anonymous text.

tokens.name: state-identified
tokens.usage: IDENTIFIED: the customer is known but not proven. Blue: information, not trust. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-identified-bg.

tokens.name: state-identified-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the IDENTIFIED chip. Pair only with state-identified text.

tokens.name: state-otp-pending
tokens.usage: OTP_PENDING: a one-time code was sent and is awaited. Orange: waiting, needs the customer. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-otp-pending-bg.

tokens.name: state-otp-pending-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the OTP_PENDING chip. Pair only with state-otp-pending text.

tokens.name: state-verified
tokens.usage: VERIFIED: identity proven by OTP. Green: the state that unlocks write tools. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-verified-bg.

tokens.name: state-verified-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the VERIFIED chip. Pair only with state-verified text.

tokens.name: state-locked
tokens.usage: LOCKED: too many failed attempts, writes refused. Crimson. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-locked-bg.

tokens.name: state-locked-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the LOCKED chip. Pair only with state-locked text.

tokens.name: state-handed-off
tokens.usage: HANDED_OFF: passed to a human agent, the assistant stops acting. Violet. Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-handed-off-bg.

tokens.name: state-handed-off-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the HANDED_OFF chip. Pair only with state-handed-off text.

tokens.name: state-active
tokens.usage: Card status ACTIVE (before card.block). Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-active-bg.

tokens.name: state-active-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the ACTIVE chip. Pair only with state-active text.

tokens.name: state-blocked
tokens.usage: Card status BLOCKED (after card.block, confirmed by receipt). Text, icon and 1px edge of the chip; sits on state-blocked-bg.

tokens.name: state-blocked-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the BLOCKED chip. Pair only with state-blocked text.

families.display: "Noto Serif Display", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", "Songti SC", "Noto Serif", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.stencil: "Big Shoulders Stencil Display", "Barlow Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif

groups.name: Title card
groups.note: Noto Serif Display at its narrowest width (font-stretch 62.5%, set by bundle.css) and heaviest weight. Uppercase, stacked in short lines.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: Hero and section title cards only: two or three short stacked lines, one per screen. Uppercase by class.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title of a screen (one per screen).

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading inside a screen or card.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-section and card titles in dense screens.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Bloqueé tu tarjeta terminada en 4821 y guardé el comprobante.
styles.usage: Default text, chat messages, form copy. 16px so mobile inputs never trigger zoom.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy; row values that must stand out.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Helper text, footnotes, timestamps, small print.

groups.name: Telemetry
groups.note: Uppercase by class. Barlow Condensed for anything that reads like an instrument label.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text, table headers, gauge names. Uppercase by class; never type capitals in source.

styles.name: mono-data
styles.usage: Tool names, receipts, timestamps, thresholds, masked values. Tabular figures.

styles.name: mono-code
styles.usage: The six-digit OTP code and other single values shown large.

styles.name: case-id
styles.usage: Case ids, audit ids as headings, list numerals. Numbers only and short codes; never body text.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap, gauge segment gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; gap between related items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in dense back-office lists; message stack gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, the page side gutter, form-field gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a card; cover margins.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards; panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section spacing in the back office.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero and title-card padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level vertical rhythm on desktop.

radius.note: Almost everything is square. The signature is the chamfer: cut-sm, cut-md and cut-lg are the size of a 45-degree cut on the top-left and bottom-right corners (clip-path), not a curve.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default. Rectangles stay square: containers, tables, tags, inputs' inner elements.

tokens.name: cut-sm
tokens.usage: Chamfer for chips, tags, switches, small buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: cut-md
tokens.usage: Chamfer for buttons, alerts, chat bubbles: the signature corner.

tokens.name: cut-lg
tokens.usage: Chamfer for cards, the chat panel, the launcher, S2 promo.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Round only for status dots and the typing indicator. Never for buttons, cards or inputs.

shadow.note: Single-layer blurs so they work as box-shadow and as filter: drop-shadow() around a chamfered element.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards. A single blur layer so it also works inside filter: drop-shadow(), which is how it follows a chamfered outline.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating things: toasts, the chat launcher, popovers. Also a single blur layer.

tokens.name: glow-sync
tokens.usage: Faint sync-green glow for live and verified elements: receipts, the online marker, decided gauges. Apply with filter: drop-shadow(var(--glow-sync)) on a chamfered element.

motion.note: Short, stepped, mechanical. Everything collapses to instant under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: motion-tick
tokens.usage: Hover and press feedback on controls.

tokens.name: motion-step
tokens.usage: Color and position changes on toggles and chips.

tokens.name: motion-scan
tokens.usage: One-shot reveals such as a receipt stamping in. Never loops except the typing indicator.

tokens.name: ease-step
tokens.usage: Stepped easing for every transition: motion is mechanical, never smooth. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Hairline rules and chamfer edges.

tokens.name: stroke-strong
tokens.usage: Stamp edges, invalid-field edges, focus outline width.

tokens.name: tick-length
tokens.usage: Length of each arm of a corner tick.
